```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Vanguard Party is a superstructure.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA and the future party must have the ability to act as an effective superstructure for all political causes relevant to the class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA and the future party should be viewed as a practically beneficial place for the class to bring their issues and rally for support.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In cases where rightist elements prevail in internal struggle, DSA is viewed as and acts semi-oppositional to more ideologically or practically advanced movements.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA derides movements that have outpaced its development as “ultra”, insurrectionary, ineffective, or accuses them of being more marginal than they are.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The goal is to make DSA a home for all kinds of liberatory political work, rather than an organization willing to cast aside a struggle that becomes too inconvenient a burden to hold alongside electoral minimum-program work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Changing DSA in this way is to create the opportunity for it to cohere a vanguard for the US working class.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Changing DSA in this way will draw the US left into a sharper focus, a focus on the formation of a party.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A party is the only structure durable enough to carry out the protection of the class and its demands to the finish line.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
